title: Stochastic Flows with Strong Shear - Part I: Strong Completeness and Set Attractors
summary: We study strong completeness and the existence of a set attractor for the stochastic flows induced by a class of two-dimensional stochastic differential equations resembling a planar Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with an additional radius-dependent rotational drift term. Our main results give both sufficient and necessary conditions for the stochastic flows to be strongly complete and for the existence of set attractors.
